data.label: PC 20090048
data.description: Bucchero fragment preserves 0.020 m of a flat, squared rim.  Below the rim on the exterior surface is a horizontal line of diagonal hatches, and below this line are a series of eight, parallel, diagonal lines with similar hatches, spaced roughly 0.002 m apart.  There appears to be a small portion of a stamp at the juncture of two break edges at a point opposite the rim.

data.label: PC 20050007
data.description: A slightly convex bucchero fragment preserves portion of a thin, rounded rim, and increases in thickness toward the body.  Near the lower break edge on the exterior surface is a roulette stamped band, approximately 0.009 m in max. pres. width, of three parallel, conjoined lines of guilloche.  Five dots are preserved in each line.

data.label: PC 20080061
data.description: Body fragment of an impasto vessel is decorated with an impressed foliate band.  Nine impressions are preserved on the surface, measuring 0.001 m in width and separated by a uniform and slightly curved horizontal indentation.

data.label: PC 20080183
data.description: Fragment preserves piece of painted fine impasto handle and handle attachment. The handle stem is preserved to 0.025 m in length with a 0.009 m diameter. Over the entire stem are traces of gray paint. The attachment is 0.024 m in length, 0.012 m in width, and 0.014 m thick. Brown paint is preserved in a band around the handle attachment measuring 0.024 m in length and 0.007 m in width.

data.label: PC 20100034
data.description: Spindle whorl fragment of truncated conical shape preserves portions of 11 ridges and a circular depression around the hole on the base.

data.label: PC 20070241
data.description: The preserved worked bone is rectangular in cross-section. The interior has been partically hollowed out at one end, about 0.022 m in diameter. At the same end a "V" has been cut into the bone with the apex carved towards the center of the bone. One side of the "V" has a chip. One horizontal edge of the bone has a incised groove 0.033 m in length and 0.002 m in width.

data.label: PC 19970186
data.description: The rim, body and tondo of a cup is preserved. The body of the cup gently curves upwards from the tondo. The rim projects upwards from the body of the cup, creating a definitive angle. The rim slants slightly inwards towards the interior of the cup. On the exterior the tondo projects downwards from the body of the cup with a low ridge defining the upper portion of the base. Only the very beginning of the curvature into the stem is preserved. On the interior of the cup, the tondo is encirlced by two incised, concentric circles. The larger of the two circles is approximately 0.048 m in diameter while the smaller circle is approximately 0.035 m in diameter. The larger of these two circles corresponds to the exterior attachment point of the base

data.label: PC 20070067

data.label: Item 945
data.description: Taweret is depicted in a very schematic way: she was represented standing up on her hind legs. The snout is square, as are the eyes and ears, both of which were made by two small protrusions on the top of the head. While the belly was swollen, the arms and the paws were not indicated. There were only summary and superficial oblique lines on the sides of the body as in the case of the baboons. This amulet-bead never have a back pillar but is characterized by a pierced hole running lengthwise.
